scenario.horizon_amendment: Extended from 120 s to 180 s after the gated zero-disturbance isolation run completed at 156.6 s; preregistered effect thresholds are unchanged.

wind_model.claim_limit: Demonstrates wind-force coupling and response only; not aerodynamic validation.

scenario.invariant_between_arms: Seed, vehicle, plant, controller, route, timing, initial state, sensors, and every non-environment configuration are identical. Current and wind are swept one variable at a time against the zero-environment baseline.

asymmetry_analysis.physical_reasoning: Flood is 1.556 m/s toward 041°, closely aligned with the first northbound leg and second 045° leg, then strongly cross-track to the final northwestward leg. Ebb is 1.038 m/s toward 213°, opposing the first two legs. Flood's 50% greater speed and alignment-driven overshoot/cross-track accumulation make a larger final displacement physically plausible; route completion and traces remain the decisive evidence.
